articles.title: Kalshi taps Solana platform for Wall Street-style high-speed data feed
articles.snippet: Kalshi is looking to meet institutional demands by adding Solana-based DoubleZero data to its order book.

articles.title: Kalshi launches sports and crypto perps data feed on DoubleZero
articles.snippet: Kalshi launched access to its sports and crypto perpetual data feed through DoubleZero’s dedicated fiber network to bolster institutional data access.

articles.title: Kalshi Adds Real-Time Market Data Feed Through DoubleZero
articles.snippet: The service gives trading firms access to Kalshi’s sports and crypto order books over DoubleZero’s fiber network.
